about.ourStoryParagraph_1: Our company is a reliable and solution-oriented import-export company established to conduct foreign trade activities between China and Turkey. We have offices in both countries, with educated and professional teams actively operating in both Turkey and China. Additionally, we have a strong partnership structure with investments in Turkey. Among these partnerships, Deko Automation Electrical and Electronic Industry and Trade Inc. stands out. Deko Elk.te manufactures low-voltage circuit breakers, which are marketed both in Turkey and worldwide.
about.ourStoryParagraph_2: Our goal is to add value to the Turkish market by sourcing high-quality products from China at competitive prices, while also promoting sustainable growth in exports by bringing our local products to the global market.
about.ourStoryParagraph_3: Thanks to our structure that quickly adapts to evolving global trade dynamics, we offer our business partners end-to-end professional services in all processes, including procurement, quality control, logistics, and customs procedures. With our strong network of manufacturers and local partnerships in China, we create secure, fast, and efficient supply chain solutions.
about.ourStoryParagraph_4: We adopt customer satisfaction as our fundamental principle and act in accordance with the principles of transparency, honesty, and continuity. Our goal is to establish long-term, trust-based relationships with our business partners and to minimize the risks encountered in trade with China, thereby providing them with a competitive advantage.
about.ourStoryParagraph_5: We are committed to being a reliable solution partner for all companies wishing to import or export from China, providing accurate guidance and smooth operational processes.

about.missionParagraph_1: We offer professional support to entrepreneurs and companies wishing to import from China at every stage, from product research to quality control, price negotiation, and logistics.
about.missionParagraph_2: By providing direct access to reliable manufacturers, we help our business partners increase their competitiveness both domestically and internationally.
about.visionParagraph_1: To be part of a system that allows importers in Turkey to source products from China quickly, securely, and under the most favorable conditions.
about.visionParagraph_2: With our knowledge of the Chinese market and our extensive network of manufacturers, we aim to make importing easy and sustainable for everyone.
about.valuesText: Reliability, transparency, customer focus, and continuous improvement are our core values. These values guide us in every project and form the basis of the strong relationships we build with our business partners. By acting in accordance with these principles in all our activities in the sector, we aim to provide high-quality and reliable services.
about.valuesCard_1_text: We improve our service quality by adapting to changing market conditions and embracing a culture of continuous learning and development.
about.valuesCard_2_text: By being bold in evaluating new opportunities, we find the best solutions for our customers.
about.valuesCard_3_text: We are committed to fulfilling our commitments and take full responsibility for all processes.
about.valuesCard_4_text: We show respect for different opinions, support diversity, and embrace everyone.
about.valuesCard_5_text: Acting in accordance with the principles of transparency and honesty, we establish long-term relationships of trust with our customers.
about.valuesCard_6_text: We achieve success together by establishing strong partnerships with our business partners in line with common goals.

whyUs.heroSubText: With over 20 years of experience in Turkey-China foreign trade and thousands of successful projects, we are your reliable solution partner.
whyUs.importProcessCard_1_text_1: We will obtain a sample or technical data of the product you require.
whyUs.importProcessCard_1_text_2: Based on the data we have, we contact our office in China to identify the exact same product, the closest alternative, or a higher quality version.
whyUs.importProcessCard_1_text_3: We prepare a visual representation of the first sample and submit it to you for approval.
whyUs.importProcessCard_2_text_1: Product prices, taxes, and other costs are clarified through customs procedures.
whyUs.importProcessCard_2_text_2: If you wish, you can handle the import process entirely on your own.
whyUs.importProcessCard_2_text_3: Or we can handle the entire import process and deliver your products to your warehouse.
whyUs.importProcessCard_3_text_1: You examine the sample, approve it, or send us your additional requests.
whyUs.importProcessCard_3_text_2: A revised sample is prepared in accordance with your specific requests and presented to you again.
whyUs.importProcessCard_3_text_3: The moment you say, “Okay, this product,” the production process begins..
whyUs.importProcessCard_4_text_1: Our professional team in China supervises every stage of production.
whyUs.importProcessCard_4_text_2: We will provide you with photos and videos to the extent permitted by the manufacturer.
whyUs.importProcessCard_5_text_1: Your own brand, product code, and barcode can be used for large orders.
whyUs.importProcessCard_5_text_2: If you wish, our graphic designer can prepare your label, box, and carton designs, or you can send us your own designs created by your own designer.
whyUs.importProcessCard_6_text_1: Products are shipped using reliable and cost-effective international shipping companies.
whyUs.importProcessCard_6_text_2: The loading stages are communicated to you with photos and videos.
whyUs.importProcessCard_7_text_1: When your shipment arrives at the port in Turkey:
whyUs.importProcessCard_7_text_2: If you wish, we can complete all customs procedures and deliver to your warehouse.
whyUs.importProcessCard_7_text_3: If you wish, you can carry out the procedures yourself.
whyUs.importProcessCard_8_text_1: We are your sole point of contact for any issues or complaints you may have.
whyUs.importProcessCard_8_text_2: We resolve exchange and return issues related to structural or technical problems with the product.
whyUs.importProcessCard_9_text_1: If you would like to clarify all the details, we can welcome you at our offices in Turkey or China.
